new_mandatory_findings.anchor: F001:absolute `re.fullmatch(r'(/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+)+', value)`; F001:check_host_predicates `probe_cg = absolute('/sys/fs/cgroup/' + rel_cg)`; F001:cmd_prelaunch_verify `rec_op0.get('self_cgroup') == current['op0_facts']['self_cgroup']`
new_mandatory_findings.issue: (1) `check_host_predicates()` passes the caller's `/proc/self/cgroup` path (`rel_cg`) to `absolute()`, whose regex omits `@` (and `:`). On standard systemd hosts where an unprivileged uid=1000 shell runs under `user@1000.service` (explicitly referenced in F002, F037, F041), `cmd_op0`, `cmd_op6`, and `cmd_prelaunch_verify` unconditionally fail with `Refusal('normalized absolute path required')`. (2) `cmd_prelaunch_verify()` requires `self_cgroup` equality with `OP-6`, refusing launch if `prelaunch-verify` runs in a different uid=1000 session/scope than `OP-6` within the same mount namespace.

new_mandatory_findings.anchor: F001:main `req_sha = sha256_regular(args.request)` and `req = validate_request(jload(args.request))`; F001:cmd_collect_evidence `obs_doc = jload(obs_path)`; F001:cmd_teardown `manifest_sha = sha256_regular(ev_manifest)`
new_mandatory_findings.issue: (1) `main()` opens `args.request` three separate times across `sha256_regular()` and `jload()` without verifying fd inode/device/digest identity between hash and parse, and takes no external `--request-sha256` CLI anchor for root steps (`op2`, `op4`, `op5`, `teardown`, `abort-prelaunch-cleanup`). (2) `cmd_teardown()` (running as root) only hashes `EVIDENCE_SHA256_MANIFEST.json` via `sha256_regular()` without `jload()` verification that `request_sha256`, `provisioner_sha256`, `observation_sha256`, and `ONE_SHOT_STARTED` match the active request and `observation_output`. (3) `cmd_collect_evidence()` does not re-verify that `execution_root` and `packet` remain active tmpfs mounts matching `obs_doc['quota_mounts']` (`mount_id`/`device`), and copies via `shutil.copy2` without hashing source files via `sha256_regular()` first.

new_mandatory_findings.anchor: F001:run_mount_tmpfs `subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount', ...])`; F001:umount_quota_tmpfs `subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/umount', '--', str(mp)], ...)`; F001:cmd_op2; F001:cmd_op4; F001:cmd_teardown
new_mandatory_findings.issue: Root steps (`OP-2`, `OP-4`, `teardown`, `abort-prelaunch-cleanup`) execute `/usr/bin/mount` and `/usr/bin/umount` without first calling `pin_operator_tool()`, and traverse `uid=1000`-writable `execution_root` (in `OP-4` and unmount steps) using non-atomic user-space `lstat()`/`is_symlink()` checks before pathname-based `mount`/`umount` subprocess calls (F005, F022, F032).

new_nonblocking_findings.anchor: F001:pin_operator_tool `cur = absolute(target) if target.startswith('/') else absolute(str(cur.parent / target))` and `not os.access(rp, os.W_OK)`
new_nonblocking_findings.issue: Relative tool symlinks containing `..` fail `absolute()` because `Path` does not collapse `..` before `'..' not in p.parts`; writability checks use `os.access(..., os.W_OK)` instead of `(st_mode & 0o022) == 0`.

`validate_request()` enforces no minimum floor on `supervisor_leaf_limits` (`L`: 1610612736 B, 64 pids, `100000 100000` cpu in F035) and no upper bound on `max_inodes` (524288/4096 in F035); `verify_and_observe()` guards superblock option checks with `if len(b) > 2:` instead of `need(len(b) > 2, ...)`.

new_nonblocking_findings.anchor: F001:cmd_op5; F001:teardown_cgroups `for ch in sorted(p_dir.iterdir(), key=lambda x: x.name):`
new_nonblocking_findings.issue: `cmd_op5` does not set `cgroup.max.depth` or `cgroup.max.descendants` (F011) on `uid=1000`-writable `P`, while `teardown_cgroups` only removes direct child directories of `P`.
F002 lacks mock tests for `cmd_op0`..`cmd_op6`, `cmd_collect_evidence`, and `cmd_abort_prelaunch_cleanup`, and tests `check_host_predicates` only with `session-1.scope` (no `@`).
